name: 笹月 (Sasazuki)
notes: [Mom & Pop] Sasazuki is a long-standing, modest neighborhood diner (machi no shokudo) tucked into the Toba 3-chome area near Nakanogo Station, a short walk from Toba Station. It sits in a quiet pocket away from the tourist bustle, serving home-style udon, ramen, and set meals to locals.

name: 弁慶 (Benkei)
cuisine: Independent Showa-retro neighborhood Chinese eatery; sweet-and-sour pork, mapo tofu, chuka-don, ramen, fried rice, and other locally loved dishes/…
notes: [Mom & Pop] A long-standing, family-run Chinese diner (machi-chuka) in Toba's 2-chome neighborhood, a short walk from Toba Station. It carries the nostalgic Showa-era atmosphere of a classic local eatery, the kind of place regulars return to for an everyday meal.
